title: Hooke's Law, Springs and Elastic Potential Energy
opener_concept: Hanging identical weights on a spring: 1 N gives 2 cm, 2 N gives 4 cm, 3 N gives 6 cm. The proportional 'cm per newton' is the spring constant, revealing F = ke by common sense.

problems_fixed.what: Stored answer 1.0 m/s was wrong (Epe=2.5 J with m=0.50 kg gives v=3.16, not 1.0; the misconception even flagged it). Changed mass 0.50 -> 0.20 kg for a clean v = 5.0 m/s; updated display + SVG label.

Stored answer 6.0 m/s was inconsistent with the stated 0.080 kg (which gives 8.49). The intended 6.0 needs m=0.16 kg. Changed mass 0.080 -> 0.16 kg so v = 6.0 exactly; updated display + SVG label; rewrote the self-contradictory misconception.

Confusing wording ('calculate the maximum compression... Enter the elastic PE... only') and a wrong SVG label 'compressed 0.063 m' (true compression is 0.089 m). Reworded to ask only for Epe = mgh = 5.88 J; replaced the wrong figure label with 'compression'.
unit field was 'N' but the answer is an extension in metres; display contained an em dash and a confusing 'then find the force' clause. Set unit to 'm'; reworded to ask total extension in metres.

Text claimed 'A force-extension graph for a spring shows...' but the figure is a spring illustration, not a graph (figure/text mismatch). Reworded to 'A spring is stretched 6.0 cm when a 15 N force is applied.' matching the spring figure; answer unchanged (250 N/m).
equation_hint contained an em dash. Replaced ' — ' with a comma to satisfy the no-em-dash rule while preserving the retrieval hint.

svg_fixes: All 14 pre-existing spring SVGs failed the validator (contained xmlns="http://..." flagged as external ref, and lacked role/aria-label). Stripped the xmlns declaration and added role="img" + aria-label to every figure. Fixed the wrong compression label on gold[2].
misconceptions: Every misconception now carries a derived numeric 'expect' (or null), each committed by simulating the specific error and confirmed to sit outside the accept window: e.g. bronze inverse_error (40/0.05=800), silver forgot_step (Epe 2.5 not v), gold wrong_length (used total 30 cm -> 10 N/m), gold rounding (g=10 -> 6.0 J). Self-contradictory silver[1]/gold[0] messages rewritten to the corrected numbers.
guided_added: Added guided.opener (proportional-weights hook), guided.teach for all three tiers (>=4 boxes each, showing the tier's one new move), tier_guides bronze/silver/gold with worked examples, tier _description lines, plain-text hints on every problem, and guided_steps on all 14 bank problems. Every walk: equation say-step, explicit cm->m conversion boxes where units are not base, a phase:'substitute' completion boundary leaving >=2 live boxes, and a closing reversal check whose 'done' states the final answer WITH its unit.
